description: Acceptance inventory. Run scripts/check.sh for component and isolated integration evidence. The bundled policy double alone establishes none of these gates. Actual Order/UI/source integrations, production calibration, archival and AWS deployment remain separate work.

serving.assert: API section 2/3 transport, duplicate-key/null/enum/unknown-field rules, auth, body limits and normalized fingerprints hold.
Atomic full refresh, limits, future/regressing timestamps and source-asOf freshness; failures preserve last valid snapshot; no request-path source fan-out.
One calculation sees one immutable release/context during concurrent refresh; DTOs contain no credentials/user identity.
Load/warm-up failure keeps readiness false; fresh catalogue/config/baseline/storage gate readiness; shutdown drains bounded work and closes policy.
Event loop remains responsive, admission is bounded with 429/Retry-After, total budget is enforced and timed-out workers retain slots until completion.
Noninteger, out-of-bound, wrong-schema or malformed results cannot issue success; unexpected errors are sanitized.
Quote and QuoteCalculated commit atomically before HTTP success; injected storage failure returns quote_recording_unavailable.
Concurrent scoped same-key calls serialize; replay survives expiry/restart/release change; changed known input conflicts; additive unknown input does not conflict.
Atomic batch validation, dedup/conflict, out-of-order linkage and commit-prefix export cursors satisfy API section 7; archival/retention are configured.
User-scoped proxy keys, matching draft revisions, explicit selected offer, durable linkage/outbox and manual-offer fallback; no scheduled quotes.
Old/new callers and replicas coexist; replayed responses retain their original release; expand/contract migrations permit rollback.

formula.assert: Short/typical/difficult fixture prices agree with documented effort assumptions; bounds do not imply a fulfilment guarantee.
Increasing walkable distance or handling quantity alone cannot lower price, including at caps; quantity adjustment is modest and bounded.
Distance-derived travel time is charged once; item-handling time and carrying adjustment have distinct documented meanings.

Singapore-time factors scale the relative pickup index; quieter locations/times cannot lower reward; multiplier stays 1..1.2 before rounding; unknown locations stay neutral. Legacy people counts cannot override release-owned indices and estimates are never labelled observed availability.

mlops.assert: Export includes exact selected policy/preprocessing/assets, complete checksums, supported majors/capabilities and fully pinned dependencies; image loads without runtime downloads.
Same versioned examples produce equivalent preprocessing and predictions offline and inside serving; omitted fields remain unknown.
Versioned datasets, seeds, code/model/release identities and mature labels are reproducible; synthetic/estimated/observed provenance stays distinct; promotion is explicit.
New image digest is deployed through readiness and serialized releases; failed rollout restores prior full release without deleting shared issuance/events.

mlops.requires: simulated dataset + LightGBM training + exported package
mlops.assert: Training uses the exported feature code; acceptance is monotone in price; holdout log loss beats the base rate; mean predicted acceptance at chosen prices is within 0.03 of 0.8; cross-generator metrics are recorded; synthetic metrics are never reported as real acceptance.
